title: Exchange Online → Gmail Migration (Mail, Calendar, Contacts)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Google Workspace + Gemini enterprise transformation; architecture/governance/integration or migration work, live-environment care).

Google Admin console + Microsoft/Entra authored click-by-click from public docs; Gemini Enterprise preview/rolling-out capabilities cited or flagged 'verify in tenant', never invented; third-party migration-tool and enterprise-app internals deferred to vendor docs.
hook: Move mailboxes to Gmail cleanly, with calendars and contacts intact
problem: Email is the highest-visibility, highest-risk part of a Google move. This solution migrates Exchange Online mailboxes to Gmail — mail, calendar, and contacts — with the right tooling pattern, mail-flow/coexistence during transition, and per-user validation, so nothing is lost and users land smoothly, executed pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Exchange-to-Gmail migration model (data types, tooling patterns, coexistence/mail routing, cutover) and the deployment model.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites (source M365/Exchange access, Google tenant/licensing, DNS/mail-flow control, a migration tool, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
Implementation Guide — exact ordered steps to configure the migration, run a named pilot batch, validate mail/calendar/contacts, manage coexistence and DNS/MX cutover, then expand by wave.
5 supporting scripts — mailbox/estate discovery, per-user migration validation, a migration coverage/exception report, safe remediation of failed items, and a wave target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (migrated, validated, mail flows) plus Best Practices for cutover and coexistence.
short: Migrate Exchange Online mailboxes to Gmail — mail, calendar, contacts — with the right tooling, coexistence/mail-flow, and per-user validation, pilot-first and rollback-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
